question: Why should a yogi not be deluded by these two paths?
premises: knowing yogi is not deluded by these paths
therefore one should be yoga-joined in all times
internal and external times are gathered into principal conclusion
inference: Knowledge of the paths removes delusion, so yoga should be practiced in every time.
uncertainties: long fused compounds are kept as single rows
plain_english: No knowing yogi is deluded by these paths; therefore be yoga-joined in all times, Arjuna.
